entries.name: Memory MCP
entries.summary: Gives agents read and write access to an Obsidian vault, a skill telling them to check it before starting work, a plugin that sets the vault up and archives old notes, plus a precached czkawka duplicate/audit cache (scoped JSON) exposed over the same MCP server.

entries.name: Devlog Update
entries.summary: Lets an agent draft and submit a devlog entry to imagoro.net after a meaningful change lands. Entries are screened and reviewed before publishing.

entries.name: Devlog Local
entries.summary: Keep a private, local change log. No network, no moderation. Appends dated entries to a Markdown file.

entries.name: Devlog Protocol
entries.summary: A fill-in-the-blank devlog protocol you adapt to your own site. Includes a config template, a posting client that pulls summaries from READMEs, and setup docs.

entries.name: Czkawka CLI
entries.summary: Scoped, precached czkawka audits (duplicates, big files, empty folders) with a quarantine-first, dry-run-by-default transfer workflow. Runs as a standalone MCP server or delegates to a vault-memory 2.0 MCP server in consolidated mode.
